hooks.name: Quality gate after each spec task
hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, check the web build, the Python tests and the white-box style before the task counts as done.

action.prompt: Quality gate for the task you just finished. 1) If anything under play/ changed, run `cd play && npm run build` and fix any error. 2) If anything under draft-service/ changed, run `.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s draft-service -p 'test_*.py'`; if anything under ai-service/ changed, run `cd ai-service && ../.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests`. Fix failures you caused. 3) For visual changes, re-read the whitebox-style steering file and check the change follows it (low saturation, robot as the hero, no signage). 4) If an interface changed, update its file in contracts/. Report the results in two or three lines.
